title: Cooking Craze
shareTitle: Cooking Craze — Pat, swirl, top, and bake a Kawaii pizza
description: Pat soft dough, swirl tomato sauce, match cheerful toppings to every slice, and slide the pizza into a warm Kawaii kitchen oven.
learningGoals: Follow a spoken four-step recipe from dough to serving
Practice broad patting and circular sauce-spreading gestures
Match six toppings to six slices with one-to-one correspondence
interactionModel: four broad dough pats, free circular sauce coverage, strand-proof topping drag with tap-to-place, and an upward peel slide to bake; all primary targets are 96 px or larger
feedbackModel: dough squishes and flour puffs under the finger; sauce fills the pizza; toppings snap with pop and sparkle; gentle spoken nudges support retries; every completed pizza earns a three-star celebration

modes.title: Build Your Pizza
modes.skill: follow four cooking steps and match six toppings

modes.title: Sauce Swirl
modes.skill: broad presses and circular sauce spreading

modes.title: Quick Bake
modes.skill: place five toppings and slide the peel to the oven
